message: I remember the time my neighbor, bless her heart, decided to prepare for a hurricane like she was hosting a royal tea party. She had enough bottled water and snacks to last a small army, and I couldn't help but chuckle as I watched her lugging cases of canned beans into her garage. Meanwhile, I was over here wondering if I had enough bread for toast! It’s nice to have a well-stocked pantry, but sometimes I think we just need to be ready for whatever the weather throws our way—without turning our homes into a mini-mart. What’s the most unexpected item you’ve stocked up on for a storm? ☔
